guidebook.intro: Biashara ndogo huendesha Afrika Mashariki: vibanda, maduka, mafundi na mawakala wa pesa. Haya ni maneno ya biashara kwa Kiingereza.

tips.title: How is it going?
body: **Inaendaje?** ni **How is it going?** au **How’s business?** Majibu: **It’s going well**, **Not bad**, **It’s slow** (inaenda polepole).
**Kupata faida** ni **make a profit**, si “get a profit”. **Kupata hasara** ni **make a loss**.

tips.title: Teach, show, give back
body: **-isha/-esha** ya Kiswahili mara nyingi ni kitenzi kipya kwa Kiingereza: **-funda → teach**, **-ona → show**, **-rudi → give back**.
Mtu huja baada ya kitenzi: **Teach me** (nifundishe), **Show me** (nionyeshe), **Give it back to me** (nirudishie).

culture.title: Savings group
body: **Chama** huitwa kwa Kiingereza **savings group**. Benki hutoa **a loan** (mkopo) na **interest** (riba).
